observations: Multiple blue cylindrical gas cylinders with rounded shoulders, standing upright on a concrete floor.
Necks show open threaded ports with no brass valve or regulator attached on any cylinder.
Stamped markings visible on the shoulders: '40.0L', 'ISO 9809-3', 'P 227.8', weight figures like '47.3 KG', and a date '2024/08'.
Worn/scratched paint and partially peeled labels/stickers on several cylinder bodies.
A darker (green/black) cylinder of different color is visible at the edge of photo 1, suggesting a mixed lot of cylinders, not all matching.
A person's hand and feet are visible in both photos; no scale reference object besides the person.
Watermark 'DE-JOE GLOBAL SERVICES' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' overlay the images.

claims.evidence: Photos show '40.0L' capacity stamp (photo 0, photo 1) but no gas-type label or valve marking confirming oxygen specifically; blue color is common for oxygen in some regions but not proof.
No certification plate, test certificate, or standard marking beyond 'ISO 9809-3' (a general cylinder manufacturing standard) is shown; grading claim cannot be confirmed from photos alone.

risks.proof: Close-up photo of the cylinder neck/valve assembly, showing brass valve and any gas-specific markings.
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete/not usable until a valve is shown fitted

risks.risk: Actual gas content (oxygen vs. another industrial gas like nitrogen or argon) cannot be confirmed from color or body stamp alone.
risks.proof: Clear photo of a gas-content label, valve stamp, or cylinder collar color-code specific to oxygen per local standard.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified/empty industrial cylinder, not confirmed oxygen-filled

risks.risk: Hydrostatic test / inspection validity date cannot be confirmed; the visible '2024/08' may be a manufacture date, not a current test date.
risks.proof: Full clear photo of the stamped test history ring (showing all test dates) near the cylinder neck.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having unknown/expired test status

risks.risk: Cylinder body condition (dents, corrosion, base damage) cannot be fully assessed from partial views.
risks.proof: Full-body photos from multiple angles including the base and any dent/rust areas.

risks.risk: Exact number of cylinders included in the sale is unclear; multiple units and a differently colored cylinder appear in photo 1.
risks.proof: Seller confirmation with a photo showing all units laid out and counted, plus labeling of what is included.
risks.if_unproven: priced per single unit only, assuming no bundle discount

proof_requests: Close-up of the cylinder neck/valve area showing whether a valve is fitted and any gas-type markings.
Clear photo of the full stamped test-date ring near the neck.
Photos of the cylinder base and any visible dents, rust, or corrosion.
Confirmation of exact quantity and whether all units are the same 40L oxygen type (vs. the differently colored cylinder visible in photo 1).
response.reason: The item is identifiable by type as a 40L industrial gas cylinder from the visible shoulder stamps, but with no valve fitted and no verifiable gas-content or test-date proof, it must be priced at its worst case as an incomplete, unverified-content cylinder.
